title: Announcements / Send learning materials or send to Canvas → Shareable link
intro: Internal board for the Essentials 2.0 solution concept (Semester → Courses → Announcements / send materials → Shareable link). Not about UI: each reference shows how another product lets someone running a course communicate from inside it: announce to everyone or a group, send selected files or links ahead of a session, choose the channel (portal feed, email, shareable link, Canvas LMS), schedule it, and see who received or opened it. One section per question; every card says what we would take from it. Counter-examples are flagged. Raw material from Mobbin and Refero, to be cut down in the converge pass before anything is shown outside the team.

questions.title: Composer: audience targeting (course / group / individual), attachment of course materials, scheduling
Channel choice (in-app feed, email, push, link, external LMS) and whether it is one composer or many features
Shareable link controls (expiry, access level, revoke, tracking)
External LMS hand-off UX (auth, mapping to course, what is sent, confirmation)
Learner-side reception (feed, notification, email) and consistency with the portal
